items: Self-review templates can use {{DEFAULT_BRANCH}}, like worker task templates
Autonomous dev and fix-bug tasks carry a run contract: never pause, and Farmslot does the push
A run created without a mode takes its default from the project's execution-template catalog
A re-review after a rebase or force-push runs as a full review that rechecks prior findings
Published PR bodies keep every AC table row and clean local paths and dead task links
Without artifacts_repo, draft PR bodies list the evidence files instead of a broken image table
Draft PR titles keep ticket keys upper-case and drop a [Terminal] prefix
